description: Starts filling in the documents of a tender in 'Moje przetargi' (forms, declarations, price form) with the company's data — the same as 'Wypełnij' in Przetargowy Janusz; it takes a few minutes. Janusz needs the offer price, the completion deadline and the signatory's name and role first: status missing_facts lists what is missing — set it with confirm_bid_price and set_fill_details, or, only after the user agrees to fill in with what there is, call again with allow_missing=true (the app's 'Wypełnij z tym co jest'). Progress: get_my_tender (last_fill); the filled files: list_tender_files. Counts toward the plan's fill limit. status: started, missing_facts, nip_required (the company's NIP is not set), fill_limit, rate_limit (8 per day per person). Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

allow_missing.description: fill in despite missing details — only when the user agreed
